title: Boss Fight Showdown
description: A surreal scene depicts a blue horned demon king seated on a golden throne atop a stone platform, holding a glowing orb while projecting purple energy and the text 'BOSS BOSS FIGHT'. A giant cracked head with multiple screaming faces floats above a fiery orange landscape. In the foreground, a soldier in green military uniform stands ready to fight beside a table with candles, film reels, and a small portrait of the demon.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a blue demonic horned king with golden crown and robe sitting on an ornate throne on a stone platform, holding a glowing orb and casting purple energy spells with text BOSS BOSS FIGHT floating nearby. A giant cracked white head with multiple screaming faces and skulls floats in the fiery red and orange sky. A soldier in green camouflage stands in fighting stance on a winding path. Foreground includes a table with lit red candles, film reels, and a small round portrait of the demon. Purple smoke, film projector showing tiny figures, flowers, dramatic cinematic lighting.
